programs.canonical:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (anti-transpose grid) (rotate-180 (transpose grid)))
    (define (transform-code grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) grid]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 4) (transpose grid)]
            [(= code 5) (flip-lr grid)]
            [(= code 6) (flip-ud grid)]
            [(= code 7) (transpose grid)]
            [else (anti-transpose grid)]))
    (let* ((cmd (at g 0 0))
           (left (subgrid g 1 0 3 2))
           (right (subgrid g 1 4 3 6))
           (tr (transform-code right cmd)))
      (grid-from-fn 3 3
        (lambda (r c) (if (and (not (= (at left r c) 0)) (not (= (at tr r c) 0))) 7 0))))))
programs.first_visible_color_per_panel:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (anti-transpose grid) (rotate-180 (transpose grid)))
    (define (transform-code grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) grid]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 4) (transpose grid)]
            [(= code 5) (flip-lr grid)]
            [(= code 6) (flip-ud grid)]
            [(= code 7) (transpose grid)]
            [else (anti-transpose grid)]))
    (let* ((cmd (at g 0 0))
           (left (subgrid g 1 0 3 2))
           (right (subgrid g 1 4 3 6))
           (tr (transform-code right cmd)) (lc (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (apply append left)))) (rc (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (apply append tr)))))
      (grid-from-fn 3 3
        (lambda (r c) (if (and (= (at left r c) lc) (= (at tr r c) rc)) 7 0))))))
